case_name: Union of India v. Tech Corp
text: The court rules that unlimited liability clauses in government contracts are against public policy and void....
Force majeure cannot be claimed solely due to economic hardship; specific performance is required....
Software services fall under the ambit of specific service tax regulations; payment terms must be strictly adhered to....

case_name: ABC Infra v. Comm. of Police
text: Termination without notice is arbitrary and violates principles of natural justice....
Data protection breaches involving sensitive personal data attract strict liability penalties under the IT Act....
